messages:
maya: heads up — nightly smoke is red for hosted-integ. lots of auth 401s on streaming and intermittent 502s on tool-calls. stack: hosted -> auth-proxy -> runtime. anyone grabbed this yet?
ci-bot: nightly-smoke | shard=12 | fail count=8 | failures: 401 /v1/stream (auth), 502 /v1/toolcall (upstream). job=nightly-smoke-2026-03-18-12:03 | logs: https://ci.internal/ops/ny-3567890123
alex: I see the CI alert. quick glance at logs shows repeated `invalid_kid` in the auth-proxy: `jwks kid not found`. Could be a JWKS rotation or cache staleness.
sam: throwing my hand up to rerun shard12 now, in case it was transient. running `./ci/rerun --shard 12 --reason "smoke auth flake"`
ci-bot: rerun queued (id=rn-3567890135)
jen: also saw a small schema change in tools last night (PR #3921) — it changed `tool.metadata` optional -> required in the contract. If toolcall responses now fail validation they might bubble as 502s. worth checking tool serializer diff.
alex: good call. combining both leads to auth errors + toolcall 502s. checking prod JWKS rotation timeline: 2026-03-18T11:47Z a new key was rolled via ksm. Auth-proxy cache TTL is 5m but our test cluster sometimes caches stale keys longer.
maya: can we repro locally? any quick patch we can try in CI to avoid noise tonight?
alex: short-term: add an auth-proxy fallback that refetches JWKS on `invalid_kid` during auth check. I can push a tiny change to the smoke runner that forces `JWKS_REFRESH=true` env for the smoke job. patching now.
alex: (patch) `ci/patches/force_jwks_refresh.sh` -> exporting `JWKS_REFRESH=true` and restarting smoke job.
ci-bot: rerun started (id=rn-3567890135) -> running shard=12
sam: while that runs, I'll open a quick followup issue to audit tool schema PR #3921 impact on toolcall validation. assigning to @jen to triage.
jen: on it — will diff serializer and try toggling the schema validation flag in staging to confirm.
ci-bot: rerun finished (id=rn-3567890135) | shard=12 | result=partial-pass | remaining fails: 2 (both 502 toolcall) | log: https://ci.internal/ops/rn-3567890135/logs
maya: progress. looks like JWKS refresh cleared the 401 storm. 502s remain — likely schema validation as jen said.
alex: I'll follow up with a small fallback in the tool deserializer to allow missing `metadata` for now behind a feature flag `ALLOW_TOOL_METADATA_MISSING`. Will land to staging and re-run.
sam: if you want, I can queue another rerun after alex's flag is in.
jen: quick note — added a small test to replicate the toolcall payload w/ missing metadata. failing locally too, so it's real.
ci-bot: queued rerun (id=rn-3567890170) after feature-flag patch merge
ci-bot: rerun finished (id=rn-3567890170) | shard=12 | result=pass | full-green
maya: nice — thanks everyone. plan: (1) alex follow up with permanent JWKS cache fix, (2) jen finalize schema fix or tighten PR to avoid breaking changes, (3) sam run a sweep of nightly shards to confirm no other stragglers. I'll file a post-smoke note in #eng-infra with links. :thumbsup:
alex: noted — I'll open PR for JWKS cache invalidation and include test.
jen: will post a small changelog for the serializer fix.
sam: will run sweep tomorrow morning and ping if anything else pops up.
maya: closing thread for now. thanks all!
